changes.reason: Geeta is Vijay's wife (since Radha is her mother-in-law and Amit's children are cousins), making Vijay the father of Ravi and Seema, hence 2 children (Option B).
Column pattern follows Row 1 + 2 × Row 2 = Row 3; in column 3, 13 + 2 × 10 = 33, so missing number ? = 10 (Option C).
Under the Twelfth Five-Year Plan (2012–2017), the targeted growth rate approved by the NDC was 8.0% for Real GDP and 4.0% for agriculture (Option B).
Area of one hexagonal tile is 216√3 ≈ 374.11 cm²; for 120,000 cm² with 5% breakage, total tiles required = (120,000 / 374.11) / 0.95 ≈ 338 tiles (Option B).
The equation (180 - y) = 2(90 - y) + 40 yields y = 40°, so the sum of the supplement (140°) and complement (50°) is 190° (Option C).
Simplification yields √[(1+sin θ)/(1-sin θ)] - tan θ = (sec θ + tan θ) - tan θ = sec θ (Option C).

In the counterfactual conditional with inversion ('Were he to have followed...'), the result clause requires 'would have' + past participle ('would have occurred', Option A).
'Lugubrious' is defined verbatim as looking or sounding sad and dismal, whereas 'sardonic' means grimly mocking or cynical (Option B).
